## What this page explains

The CVD tables refresh automatically when the CVD event or mortality Step 6 replaces the approved website data files and the website is rendered and deployed. **No separate table-refresh action is required.**

This page is technical reference material for maintaining or checking the tables.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="No separate refresh action"}
Do not edit the tables page for a routine data release. Complete the relevant Step 6 analytical publication, then follow the normal website render and deployment process. The tables discover the available periods from the approved data.
:::

## Page and approved inputs

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `site/surveillance/cvd/tables/index.qmd` | Quarto and Observable presentation code for the public CVD tables. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/cvd_metrics_current.csv` | Current approved CVD event measures. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/cvd_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | Fixed approved CVD event monthly reference. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv` | Current approved mortality measures. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | Fixed approved mortality monthly reference. |

The page loads these files with `FileAttachment`, reorganises their approved rows for display and creates browser-side selected-view downloads. Those downloads are not official data releases.

## Checks during normal website review

After the normal site render, check the tables as part of website review:

- event and mortality tabs open correctly;
- period, measure, definition and stratum controls show only supported choices;
- protected, unavailable and incomplete values have the correct labels;
- compare a small selected of tabulation cells with the same values on the dashboard or in the public release dataset; and
- the page works at narrow and wide browser widths where practical.
